about: measure contests of 2016 in Mississippi, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, State Precinct-Level Returns 2016 (Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/GSZG1O) and Local Precinct-Level Returns 2016 (Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/Q8OHRS)
medsl.note: MEDSL's older layout, read for its questions only by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py 2016; files 2016-precinct-local.csv, 2016-precinct-state.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

census_places.name: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census: national_place_by_county2020.txt (each place once for each county it lies in; codes2020 reference files)
census_places.licence: a work of the U.S. Government (17 U.S.C. 105); no licence printed

census_cousub.name: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census: national_cousub2020.txt (each county subdivision with its county; codes2020 reference files): towns and townships with a government of their own (FUNCSTAT A), which nest within their county, and the names that are both a place's and a subdivision's
census_cousub.licence: a work of the U.S. Government (17 U.S.C. 105); no licence printed

medsl_county_precincts.name: each county's precincts in MEDSL's file on the date, counted from the same files as the contests (a precinct with a vote in any contest; in 2016, any general-election row)
medsl_county_precincts.where: each county's own question: place_whole.precincts and place_whole.county_precincts

question.title: Question: For The Transportation, Storage, Sale, Distribution, Receipt And/Or Manufacture Of Win And Beer In Franklin County, Ms

place_whole.how: the title names the record's own county, Franklin County, and no other body

notes: counted whole: held in one county's file only, and its title is the county's own question (the title names the record's own county, Franklin County, and no other body; [inferred]); every voter on a county's own question is in that county, and it covers all 14 of the county's precincts in MEDSL's file [measured]

p.not_computed: the thresholds of this state's local questions are not read

question.title: Measure No. -1 Non-Binding Referendum On Consolidation Of Judicial Districts

notes: counted by county: MEDSL's wording of a local question does not show which place holds it, so a question held across several counties appears once per county

p.not_computed: a local measure: its threshold is the one state law sets for its kind of measure, which the source's wording does not show, and the place that holds it is not shown either (it is counted by county); not inferred (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 06:16)
